name: empty list
code:
result = detect_cycle(None)
assert result is None

name: single node, no cycle
code:
head = ListNode(1)
result = detect_cycle(head)
assert result is None

name: single node, self-loop cycle
code:
head = ListNode(1)
head.next = head
result = detect_cycle(head)
assert result == 0

name: two-node cycle
code:
a = ListNode(1)
b = ListNode(2)
a.next = b
b.next = a
result = detect_cycle(a)
assert result == 0

name: cycle starting at second node
code:
a = ListNode(1)
b = ListNode(2)
c = ListNode(3)
a.next = b
b.next = c
c.next = b
result = detect_cycle(a)
assert result == 1

name: no cycle on three-node list
code:
a = ListNode(1)
b = ListNode(2)
c = ListNode(3)
a.next = b
b.next = c
c.next = None
result = detect_cycle(a)
assert result is None

name: large tail-to-head cycle
code:
nodes = [ListNode(i) for i in range(100)]
for i in range(99):
    nodes[i].next = nodes[i+1]
nodes[99].next = nodes[0]
result = detect_cycle(nodes[0])
assert result == 0

name: cycle in middle of long list
code:
nodes = [ListNode(i) for i in range(100)]
for i in range(99):
    nodes[i].next = nodes[i+1]
nodes[50].next = nodes[25]
result = detect_cycle(nodes[0])
assert result == 25

name: two-node tail with self-loop
code:
a = ListNode(1)
b = ListNode(2)
a.next = b
b.next = b
result = detect_cycle(a)
assert result == 1

name: long chain then loop at index 3
code:
nodes = [ListNode(i) for i in range(50)]
for i in range(49):
    nodes[i].next = nodes[i+1]
nodes[49].next = nodes[3]
result = detect_cycle(nodes[0])
assert result == 3
